tickets.title: One overlap check for booking and rescheduling
tickets.description: Design change, no new requirement: booking a room (REQ-002) and changing the time of a booking (REQ-010) must reject overlaps (REQ-003) by the same rule. Move the overlap and time slot check into one class of its own that both use, and show it in the class and sequence diagrams. Behaviour stays as it is.

steps: P2: Add a new domain class (e.g. BookingRuleChecker) in Domain Services DSN-018 with one method that takes roomId, start, end, now and an optional excludeId, runs the TimeSlotPolicy validation and rejects overlaps with non-cancelled bookings of the same room via BookingRepository.findOverlapping; trace it to REQ-003, REQ-007, REQ-002 and REQ-010.

P2: Give the new class dependencies on TimeSlotPolicy DSN-009 and BookingRepository DSN-012; replace BookingService DSN-007's direct 'validates with' dependency on DSN-009 with a dependency on the new class, keeping its BookingRepository and RoomRepository dependencies.

P2: Update SEQ-002 so BookingService.create calls the new class's check in place of the direct validate call, followed by RoomRepository.findById and BookingRepository.saveIfFree (atomic insert unchanged).

P2: Update SEQ-004 so BookingService.changeTime calls the new class's check (with the booking's own ID excluded) in place of the direct validate and findOverlapping calls, followed by BookingRepository.update.

P4: Create the new class file under src/domain-services, move the slot and overlap check out of BookingService.create and changeTime into it, inject it into BookingService and wire it in src/app/app.ts; keep error messages and order of checks so behaviour stays the same.
P5: Run the existing UC-002 and UC-004 tests unchanged (REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-007, REQ-010) to confirm behaviour is unchanged; add a unit test for the new class if wanted.

report.text:
TCK-001 asked for one shared rule for rejecting overlaps (REQ-003) when booking a room (REQ-002) and when changing a booking's time (REQ-010). The overlap and time slot checks were to move into a class of their own, shown in the class and sequence diagrams, with no change in behaviour and no new requirement.

Design (P2): A new class, BookingRuleChecker (DSN-024), was added under Domain Services and traces to REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-007 and REQ-010. Its check method runs the time slot validation in TimeSlotPolicy, then asks BookingRepository for overlapping bookings. It ignores cancelled bookings and, when given an excludeId, the booking being changed. BookingService (DSN-007) now depends on BookingRuleChecker instead of TimeSlotPolicy. Both sequence diagrams, SEQ-002 (book a room) and SEQ-004 (change a booking's time), now call check and no longer validate or look up overlaps directly. In the architecture diagram, click links were added for the five components, which is why DSN-018 appears as changed. Its requirement list did not change.

Code (P4): BookingRuleChecker.ts was created. BookingService.create and changeTime now call the checker instead of running their own copies of the overlap and slot code. app.ts builds the checker and passes it to BookingService, and README.md lists the new class. detect_drift was clean. Typecheck failed at first because test/UC-002.test.ts and test/UC-009.test.ts still passed a TimeSlotPolicy to BookingService.

Tests (P5): The tests for UC-002, UC-004 and UC-009 now build a BookingRuleChecker. The SEQ-002 and SEQ-004 scenario tests now check that the calls happen in the order the diagrams show. SEQ-002 then failed because create looked up the room before calling check. This was logged as a code bug (issue 20261127-134134-P5-1) and fixed in the second P5 run: create now calls check first, then looks up the room. One small side effect: a request that is both overlapping and aimed at a deactivated room now gets the overlap error rather than the deactivated-room error. Final result: 58 passed, 0 failed.

Deployment (P6): No files changed. deploy_check got status 200 and "ok" from /health.

Still open:
- REQ-008 criteria 1 to 4 have no coverage. The P2 agent reports this gap existed before the ticket; it was not closed here.
- The P2 summary raised a question about how excludeId is handled in check, but the question is cut off. In the code it is null when booking and the booking's own ID when rescheduling.
- ADMIN_PASSWORD in the deployment files is still a placeholder and must be changed before real use.

steps.summary: At the P2 design gate, the agent added `BookingRuleChecker` (DSN-024) under Domain Services, rewired `BookingService` and the two sequence diagrams to use it, and left the code phases untouched. The first `report_coverage` call failed and the retry succeeded, so coverage was reported. Check that REQ-008 criteria 1 to 4 are still uncovered, as the agent says they already were before this ticket, and decide whether that gap is acceptable at this gate. Also confirm that `excludeId` in `check` is the right place for the self-exclusion from the ticket, since the diagrams cannot show it.

The code now matches the new design and `detect_drift` is clean, and `start_app` came up ok, but `typecheck` still fails with two errors in test files I'm not allowed to edit. Those are `test/UC-002.test.ts` (line 86) and `test/UC-009.test.ts` (line 27), which still pass a `TimeSlotPolicy` as the first argument to `BookingService`. Before approving, you'll need to decide who updates those tests to build a `BookingRuleChecker` instead, since the phase can't pass typecheck until they do. The rest of the change is `BookingRuleChecker` in `src/domain-services/BookingRuleChecker.ts` (DSN-024), `BookingService` (DSN-007) now delegating slot and overlap checks to it, and `src/app/app.ts` wiring it in, with no changes for DSN-018.

The agent updated the SEQ-002 and SEQ-004 tests and fixed a constructor signature break in SEQ-009, and typecheck passes. SEQ-004 now passes, while SEQ-002 still fails because the code looks up the room before calling `check`, so it was logged as a code bug for REQ-002 and the test was left unchanged. Before approving, check whether the REQ-002 fix (call `check` first) is scheduled, and re-run `run_tests` because the UC-009 edit was made after the last run, which had 57 passing and only the SEQ-002 failure.

The agent ran one fix round in the P5 testing phase, fixed issue 20261127-134134-P5-1, and reported no open issues, no declined fixes and no test files changed by triage. All five tool calls succeeded, including the typecheck and drift check, and none failed. Before approving, you may want to confirm that the fix for 20261127-134134-P5-1 is what you expected, since the summary does not describe what the issue was or what changed.

The agent made no file changes in P6 because the existing Dockerfile, compose.yaml and RUN.md already matched the plan, including the `ADMIN_PASSWORD` placeholder and its warning to change it before real use. A single `deploy_check` against the new code returned 200 from `/health` with `{"status":"ok"}`, and no tool call failed. Before approving, confirm that the placeholder password is changed or otherwise handled before any real use, since the agent only reported the note and did not act on it.
